criterion_descriptions: Navigate to OpenStreetMap and attempt to use its search (e.g., the provided starting URL) for 'British Museum, London'. Full credit if the agent reaches OSM search or clearly reports a blocker such as CAPTCHA, downtime, network errors, or content not loading. Partial credit if the agent uses an unclear/non-OSM method without first attempting OSM.

From OSM search results (or map selection), open the matching object page for the British Museum on Great Russell Street in London (not another similarly named result). Full credit if the correct object page is opened. Partial credit if the agent finds the museum but opens an ambiguous/nearby/related feature (e.g., entrance, stop, perimeter sub-feature) or does not open the object page. Full credit if the agent documents that no exact/unique match is available in results or that search results are incomplete/buggy, despite reasonable attempts (e.g., trying alternate queries, map click selection).

Report the OSM object type (node/way/relation) and its ID exactly as displayed on the opened British Museum object page. Full credit if both are correct. Partial credit if only one is reported or if there are minor transcription errors that are clearly identifiable from context.

Extract and report the 'addr:street' tag value from the object page. Full credit if correctly reported or explicitly reported as unavailable if the tag is not present/visible. No credit for inferring the value when it is not displayed.

Extract and report the 'addr:city' tag value from the object page. Full credit if correctly reported or explicitly reported as unavailable if the tag is not present/visible. No credit for inferring the value when it is not displayed.

Extract and report the 'addr:postcode' tag value from the object page. Full credit if correctly reported or explicitly reported as unavailable if the tag is not present/visible. No credit for inferring the value when it is not displayed.

Extract and report the 'tourism' tag value from the object page. Full credit if correctly reported or explicitly reported as unavailable if the tag is not present/visible. No credit for inferring the value when it is not displayed.

Extract and report the 'museum' tag value from the object page. Full credit if correctly reported or explicitly reported as unavailable if the tag is not present/visible. No credit for inferring the value when it is not displayed.

Extract and report the 'website' tag value from the object page. Full credit if correctly reported or explicitly reported as unavailable if the tag is not present/visible. No credit for guessing a website when it is not displayed.

Agent does not sign in or attempt to edit OpenStreetMap, and stops once the exact British Museum object plus all requested identifiers and tag values (or explicit unavailability) are recorded. Full credit if constraints are followed. Partial credit if minor unnecessary browsing occurs without violating sign-in/edit constraints.
